== Biography ==

Tortoise was the master of an underwater school where he instructed young creatures including the Mock Turtle and the Gryphon. Though he was in truth an old Turtle rather than a Tortoise, his pupils called him by that peculiar name because he taught them—a delightful play upon words that, as the Mock Turtle later insisted with some heat, required no further explanation to those of sufficient understanding.
